title: Review: consistent match pattern for try_send in SSE handler
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — both try_send sites break on Full/Closed identically to the old code; the only change is a warn log. The log ambiguity is real but does not affect correctness or security. No new API surface, no new invariants.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug.   Uncertainty driven by: (1) no test exercises the Full path — the behavior on a genuinely full channel cannot be verified from the test suite; (2) the interaction between the coalescing task exiting via break-without-None and the ReceiverStream termination is implicit in tokio channel drop semantics — this was verified by reading the code but not by a test.   Would raise confidence if: a test filled the mpsc channel and verified the SSE stream terminated cleanly without hanging.
